intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.8.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 57.6 KB gzip initial shell -68.4%, 16.38 MB RSS -85.8% vs v1.2.0, Deterministic Playtest Assertion Suite + 1-Click Re-Run, Monetization Tier Presets & 48h Comeback Retention Curve Designer, Unified Pre-Publish Gate, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, and Rojo .zip export at 7,501 req/s 16w pinned with 2.48ms p95), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.5.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with worker duration pills & inline Quick-Action nudge bar, Windowed Board of 80 posts, keyboard triage j/k/o/p/1-5, Worktree changed-file links, live /api/swarm/stream SSE push, and FleetToaster CSS diet giving 377.7 KB raw / 112.5 KB gz, 59.5ms boot -29.7%, 2,326 req/s 16w pinned +75.6%, 9.45ms p95, and 22/22 fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.17.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 11.76 MB fat-LTO binary, 26.19 MB RSS -49.9% vs v0.11.0, 1-Click Run/Receipt Comparison & Delta Client Pack .md, Unified Fuzzy Cmd+K jump, clickable [file:L##] Source Inspector, Promote to Playbook, Pre-Flight Check, and 5,420 req/s 16w pinned at 3.94ms p95).
